card.name: Linking words before treatment options
card.fires_on: Small linking words (comma, a, with, are, include) right where a list or description of treatments is about to begin, in patient-education text about eye disease, skin conditions or tumors.

modes.label: Lists of treatments
modes.description: A comma, bullet mark or verb like include sits just before the next treatment in a list of options.
modes.example: Treatment options include prescription eye drops<<,>> oral medications and surgery

modes.label: Treated with a/with
modes.description: The word a or with comes right after treated or treatment, before the therapy is named.
modes.example: Small tumors may be treated with<< a>> medication, such as a dopamine agonist

card.writes: It seems to add a push toward words like custom, oral and lifestyle, which fit the type of treatment that comes next.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a treatment is named, such as the with in treated with.
